c0028: Share of sales that arrives through a wedding planner or a venue marketplace (such as Peerspace) that charges a commission. c0092: Months of rent BEFORE opening (permitting & build-out)

c0104: Month of the 12-Month Cash Flow in which a holiday extra payment falls. It only matters if you enter more than 12 pay periods; with 12 there are no extra payments. If you use it, December is Month 10, because Month 1 of the plan is March

c0168: Sofas, mood lighting, mirrors and fixed decor for the bridal suite and the groom's lounge

c0178: Brand identity, a website with an availability calendar, a photo shoot and a video of the venue set up
c0180: LLC formation and an attorney for the lease (extensions, purchase option, the owner's consent to the build-out and to using the lease as collateral) and your contracts, plus the setup with your CPA / bookkeeper. c0387: Overhead hours per event, outside the event day
c0388: Hours per event outside the event day: tours and meetings with couples, planning with the caterer, maintenance, grounds, cleaning and admin. This is the part of the team that works all year, spread across the events
